answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose Stepwise Correction (STEPCO), an iterative verify-then-revise framework for LLMs on reasoning tasks. [...] We evaluated STEPCO on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks and extended it to open-domain question answering and commonsense reasoning tasks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate open-domain QA tasks, such as the HotpotQA, using exact match (EM) and F1-score, and use accuracy for other tasks.

answer_3.quote: We utilize LoRA to fine-tune the Llama-3-8B model on the process supervision dataset [...] to develop the process-supervised verifier (PSV). [...] The PSV then predicts the probability that step s i leads to the correct answer.
